bld.route_reason: deckenmalerei.eu building 'Denklingen, Pfarrkirche St. Michael' carries this QID (P10626); the item 'St. Michael, Pfarrkirche in Denklingen' agrees in place and dedication.

_:person:franz-xaver-kleinhans.route_reason: Franz Xaver Kleinhans (1699–1776), Rococo architect in the Hochstift Augsburg, which owned Denklingen; dates fit the building of 1765/66. The inscription calls him 'Johannes Kleinhans aus Tirol' (Kleinhans came from Tyrol).

_:person:ignaz-finsterwalder.route_reason: Ignaz Finsterwalder (1708–1772), German stuccoist; the only stuccoist of the name, dates fit 1765/66.

_:person:joseph-ignaz-philipp-von-hessen.route_reason: Joseph Ignaz Philipp von Hessen-Darmstadt, Fürstbischof von Augsburg 1740–1768: same office and years as printed ('Landgraf von Hessen-Darmstadt und Fürstbischof von Augsburg (1740–68)').

_:person:johann-joseph-anton-huber.route_reason: Johann Joseph Anton Huber (1737–1815), Baroque painter and later director of the Augsburg academy, as the article says ('der spätere Akademiedirektor in Augsburg'); signed 1767.

schmid.route_reason: Very common name: of ~40 items named Joseph/Josef Schmid none is an 18th-century priest (Q93521098, 1698–1769, died before 1782). A curator decides whether to create one.
